golden.line: You are so grand and golden
stanza: I wrote it in about 2006. I noticed America was becoming more and more downtrod…
America!
America!
America!
You are so grand and golden
Oh I wish I was deep in America tonight

golden.line: I have had friendships, pure and golden
stanza: I have had friendships, pure and golden
But the ties of kinship, I have not known them
I know no mother, no father
No sister, no brother
I am an orphan girl

golden.line: Is the sun shining golden (Sun shining golden)
stanza: I know, when I get there
The first thing I'll see
Is the sun shining golden (Sun shining golden)
Shining right down on me

golden.line: Squeeze it and hold it 'cause we consider these minutes golden
golden.linePrev: That's why we seize the moment, try to freeze it and own it
golden.lineNext: And maybe they'll admit it when we're gone

golden.line: Why, the fame and all the golden
stanza: What a wonderful way to live
She's travelling all over the world
Why, the fame and all the golden
Opportunities unfurled
No time for the gent with the Mulliner Bentley
And heaven knows what else
Why, he wouldn't even stand a chance
With all his oil-wells

golden.line: And Jill got me living like my life is golden
golden.linePrev: Right got the whip and I ain't got the license for it
golden.lineNext: Sitting on the sofa feeling high and dormant

stanza: We are stardust
We are golden
And we got to get ourselves
Back to the garden
